negative_snippets:
I booked this hotel through the OYO app. The price shown on the app was different, and I had already paid an extra amount as a pre-booking charge. But after reaching the location, I found out that the hotel shown on OYO was fake — there was no such hotel at that address.
There was another hotel nearby with a different name. I tried calling the owner many times after booking, but he did not receive any calls. I waited for almost 1 hour, still no response. There was absolutely no support.
Finally, I had no option and decided to go to Hotel Yellow Chilli. The manager there clearly said that there is no OYO booking, and if I wanted a room, I had to pay ₹1200 extra. In total, I spent around ₹1500, which was completely unfair.
Even after paying so much, the room experience was terrible. The room was smelly, towels were dirty, and overall cleanliness was very poor. Totally unhygienic.
This was the worst hotel experience of my life. They are scammers. I strongly recommend never booking this hotel or trusting this listing on OYO.

Never never never go there such a horrible experience 😭😭

I visited here in month Nov-25. According to the room charges room condition was not satisfactory. Bed, blanket and bedsheet was not cleaned after touching this we can feel dust on your hands. No slippers provide Even requested twise. Light was dim. Washroom-bathroom were in good condition and food was excellent. I ordered Matter allu sabji with chappatis, salad was complementary I was excellent 👌 and tea also ordered which was excellent. Then later on i ordered ver chowmin and tea these were also very tasty and late evening i ordered French fries and tea, again these were also Great.
Quality of food with such minimum rates was amazing.
Overall I will give 3 stars for room condition.
